title: How I Learned to Love English
text:
When I was at school, I used to hate English lessons. We spent hours memorising grammar rules and lists of words, but we never actually spoke. I could fill in gaps in a test, but when a tourist asked me for directions, I froze.

Everything changed when I started working at a hotel in Antalya. At first, I wasn't used to speaking English all day, and I made a lot of mistakes. Some guests corrected me, which was embarrassing. However, most people were patient, and slowly I got used to it. I also started watching series with English subtitles and writing down useful phrases in a notebook.

The most important lesson I learned is that mistakes are part of learning. Native speakers don't expect you to be perfect; they just want to understand you. Today I still make mistakes, especially with phrasal verbs, but I'm no longer afraid of speaking. In fact, I'm looking forward to taking the IELTS exam next spring.
